scope: Original AA.exe trigger system: all 115 registered elements (546AF0 dispatch, selectors, TriggerElement leaves, Kingdom objective/mission-result methods, CRT command formatting), the TRIGGERS loader (54D3D0, manager v4/v5) and the MAPSTRINGS loader and localized binding (47EA40, 49AD70).
fpu: Precision control is an explicit input (CoreProgram::precision); callers pass PC53 (world tick). Numeric opcodes are proven at PC24/PC53/PC64. Opcode 68 (FYL2X): the binary32 store is proven; FYL2X is extended precision and not correctly rounded, Unicorn computes it via binary64, so Rust refuses results within 2^-40 of a binary32 rounding boundary. Camera angles and 4454A0 rotation are seams.

corpora.scope: ORIGINAL VC7.1 _vswprintf (96C7EC) wide %f/%.2f/%d formatting; C locale via _getptd seam.
the 26 element types no campaign mission uses (round 2)
Oracle: ORIGINAL TRIGGERS chunk loading (TriggerManager 54D3D0) for every original map.

corpora.note: phase7 world opcodes 43/44/54/61/62/63/64/114; now dispatched through the shared phase8 selectors

native_ported_functions.546AF0: dispatch order of every ported case (argument registers evaluated right-to-left as native)
native_ported_functions.5422F0/54A5A0: register conversion incl. element kind (+1C) used for context writes
native_ported_functions.54DAC0/54DC20: Kingdom/actor selectors with event/condition context writes (manager+24/+28/+10)
native_ported_functions.5452A0/543BA0: named and transported creation (incl. 4281E0/409230 vector math)
native_ported_functions.54D3D0/541410/5468A0/54A640: TRIGGERS records, manager v4/v5, element v2/v3, 544190 rules explicit

gaps: All world services behind the seams (UI script commands, audio, camera angle tables, creation, placement, command processing, abilities/flares, Kingdom heroes/properties/resources, teleports, morale 579750 -> aa_combat::morale::modify, fog tile pass, game speed) need runtime bindings.
Native null dereferences are explicit errors (missing TeamVictory var, transport+C0, flare+57C, missing difficulty variable, Kingdom+1C4, stale Area+84 GTID, null organization arrays).

Registers (manager+2C) are reused natively between elements; the +4 string slot is modelled and used by the ma_hero register (random-hero item 28 of 35/48/49 ported); other non-owned storage reads are explicit errors.
Opcode 68: results within 2^-40 of a binary32 rounding boundary are refused (FYL2X not ground truth).
TRIGGERS manager versions 0-3, element versions 0/1 and 544190 upgrade rules are explicit errors (none in the maps).

MAPSTRINGS: escapes, UTF-8 BOM with non-ASCII, >2047-byte lines, non-[Text] nodes and mixed language attributes are refused; non-ASCII text lookups and keys missing from MAPSTRINGS are explicit errors.
Locale traced: the only setlocale calls (7F19D9/7F1A08/7F1AA1) keep LC_NUMERIC at "C"; LC_CTYPE never changes, so the MAPSTRINGS reader, _wcsicmp and printf run in the C locale on every code page.
